name: The Cloud Stair

sub_locations.name: The Lower Flights
sub_locations.description: Cut into the scarp, wide enough for two, worn in the middle like any stair anyone ever used.

sub_locations.name: The Turn
sub_locations.description: Where the stair stops climbing the rock and starts climbing away from it. There is no rock under the last four steps and they are still there.

description: A stair up the scarp that keeps going after the scarp stops.
arrival: You can follow it with your eye until the cloud takes it, and the cloud is not always there, and it goes up past where the cloud is. Nobody at the University will say it is not a stair. They will say it has not been surveyed.
notes: The anomaly, and the hook toward region_tethys_sky_routes for a later map. Deliberately unresolved -- the ladder ends at a good description rather than an explanation, because some things should stay open.
